capabilities: Chat with the open note and selections
Search vault notes and the web
Review and accept or decline proposed edits
Switch between Codex, OpenCode, Claude Code and Hermes Agent
extras: Desktop only (macOS/Windows); Linux and mobile unsupported. Free MIT, but provider plans or credits may apply. Saved chats and recovery snapshots are written outside the vault.
problem: Obsidian users who already have an assistant CLI lack a vault-aware chat that can read notes and propose changes without uploading the whole vault or writing directly.
